offering_description.value: W. R. Berkley underwrites commercial property and casualty insurance for businesses, personal coverage for high-net-worth customers, and reinsurance for insurers. Its specialized businesses tailor coverage to particular risks and also provide risk management and insurance administration services.

quotes.quote: The Berkley brand comprises approximately 60 (re)insurance businesses, each offering expertise within an industry, product, region, or alternative distribution.
The Company also entered the risk management and administration services sector by forming Berkley Risk Administrators Company.

primary_products.value: commercial property and casualty insurance including excess and surplus coverage; workers’ compensation insurance; professional liability insurance; high-net-worth personal insurance; property and casualty reinsurance

quotes.quote: the Company announced its entry into the high net worth personal lines market with Berkley One. It also formed Berkley Insurance Asia, Berkley Transactional, Berkley Cyber Risk Solutions and Intrepid Direct.

Berkley Construction Solutions was formed to provide excess liability insurance for contractors throughout the construction industry. In addition, Berkley E&S Solutions was founded to provide surplus lines casualty coverage to middle-market and large accounts and Berkley Enterprise Risk Solutions was created to provide workers compensation insurance to large businesses, headquartered in California.
The Company also entered the risk management and administration services sector by forming Berkley Risk Administrators Company.

Architects and engineers face unique challenges that demand comprehensive, cost-effective insurance solutions. Berkley Design Professional delivers state-of-the-art professional liability coverage designed exclusively for design firms of all sizes and disciplines. Our sole focus is the architecture and engineering industry, providing risk and practice management from true industry practitioners. When an alleged error or omission occurs, a design firm can quickly become entangled in costly disputes or litigation—impacting finances, time, and reputation.
